parsed.rationale: I don't see RBBB: the QRS looks near-normal width, and lead I and V6 lack the wide slurred terminal S wave. The tracing shows a tall R in V1 with a downsloping ST segment and T inversion, right axis deviation, and persistent S waves through V5–V6, which fits right ventricular hypertrophy with strain rather than a bundle branch block. There is no ST elevation, so STEMI criteria are not met.
